Front's MCP server (`mcp.frontapp.com/mcp`) lets AI agents act on Front conversation data using a single OAuth-authenticated endpoint.
This article covers how to connect any MCP-compatible client to Front using an OAuth app you create yourself in the Front developer settings.

Once your integration has been technically approved, our team will use the image and marketing details you submit in the form to launch your integration with a dedicated landing page on our website and in our app.
